title: R2: Free local headroom check: supervised baseline vs published human ceiling ($0)
description:
## Purpose

Free local headroom check: does the label set carry LEARNABLE signal, and how far is the human ceiling? Pass criterion (c) needs this.

## Scope

- Per candidate: define pool / dev / held-out splits (seeded; pool only for training and for screening items; held-out never inspected for tuning).
- Train a local supervised baseline (e.g. TF-IDF + logistic regression) on a few hundred pool labels (report 200 / 400 / all-pool if cheap); score macro-F1 on held-out with bootstrap CI.
- Put it next to the published inter-annotator / human ceiling from R0.
- Requires the data locally: only datasets the owner approved for download after R0.

## Definition of done

Table per candidate: supervised baseline macro-F1 (CI) at each training size, human ceiling, split sizes and seeds; text-free provenance (ids, hashes) committed; comment posted here.

## Cost

$0: no Jev or other model calls.
